services.intro: Eight clear services, built for Québec businesses and shops.

items.name: Website creation
items.note: A clear structure, smooth navigation, content that gets straight to the point: a premium web experience that reflects how serious your business is — and makes people want to call.

items.name: Existing site rebuild
items.note: We analyze what’s there, pinpoint what’s blocking conversion, then rework every element — structure, speed, content — for a site that pushes the visitor to contact you.

items.name: Hosting
items.note: We handle everything: a fast server, a security certificate, regular backups and continuous monitoring. Your site stays online, fast and protected — at all times.

items.name: Professional email addresses
items.note: An email on your own domain changes everything — instead of a generic Gmail, your customers see an established, serious business that earns trust from the very first exchange.

items.name: Logo and brand identity
items.note: From a standalone logo to a full identity: creative directions, variants, palette, typefaces and source files. A complete rebrand is possible, with a brand guide and launch preparation.

items.name: VPS servers
items.note: For an application or a CRM that needs more than a showcase site: 1 to 8 vCPUs, 4 to 32 GB of RAM and NVMe storage, managed and monitored on our side.

items.name: CRM and automations
items.note: A CRM in your image: leads, sales pipeline, dashboard and connected forms. Automations link the site, the CRM and your external software.

items.name: Blog and SEO content
items.note: Built-in CMS, articles written and published on a regular cadence, reviewed with you. Content is structured for local search from day one.

method.intro: No black box: you always know where your project stands, and what’s left for you to decide.

steps.title: We listen
steps.desc: A 45-minute call. You talk trade, we note down what really matters to your customers.

steps.title: We analyze
steps.desc: We look at your current site and your market: an honest read of what works, what’s missing and what would pay off the most.

steps.title: We plan a strategy, not just a site
steps.desc: A plan built for your trade: which pages, which calls to action, which structure to bring in qualified requests.

steps.title: We build to best practices
steps.desc: Bilingual, fast, mobile-optimized, structured for Google from the start. You watch the site take shape — we handle the technical details.

steps.title: We polish it together
steps.desc: Final review before launch: we go over every detail with you before putting the site live.

steps.title: We put the site live
steps.desc: The site is deployed and ready to receive visitors.

proof.title: Social proof — reserved slot
proof.note: Real testimonials only, with written permission. Until there are some, this section stays off: the page stands without it.

faq.intro: The questions we get before every project, and our answers.

items.a: A website starts at $499, a logo at $200 and hosting at $35 per month. Every plan and what it includes is detailed on the {link}. If your project falls outside these plans, we give you a firm price after a free call.
items.aPricing: A website starts at $499, a logo at $200 and hosting at $35 per month. The exact inclusions of every plan are in the tables above. If your project falls outside these plans, we give you a firm price after a free consultation call.

items.q: How long does it take to build a site?
items.a: For simple projects, count on 3 to 5 days, especially if you already have your photos and copy ready. For more complex projects, it can take a few weeks.

items.q: I have no copy or photos.
items.a: No problem — it’s the most common situation. We guide you with the copy, and we find or create the photos that fit.

items.q: I already have a website, but it’s weak. Do you rebuild it?
items.a: Yes, a rebuild is entirely possible. We start with a consultation to analyze your current site, then guide you through the whole rebuild process.

items.q: Will the site be in both French and English?
items.a: Yes, all our sites are built bilingual by default, so you can reach your entire customer base, whatever their language.

items.q: How will my customers reach me or book a meeting?
items.a: They have several easy ways to reach you: a request right on the site, an email, a phone call, or even a message on social media. From there, you schedule the consultation with them, however suits you.

items.q: Will I be able to manage my blog myself?
items.a: Yes, you’re free to manage your blog yourself. And if you’re short on time or would rather not, we can handle it for you too.

items.q: Will the site rank well on Google?
items.a: Every site is built to SEO best practices: speed, mobile, page structure and local content. Google decides the final ranking, but your site starts on solid ground.

final.title: Your next contract starts with a phone call.
final.body: One free 45-minute call is enough to pin down your need. No commitment.
final.note: Reply within 24 hours, Monday to Friday.
